newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Four bids go through in S.Africa's Sun Air sale.
newsitem.headline: Four bids go through in S.Africa's Sun Air sale.

text.p: All four groups submitting non-binding offers for the privatisation of domestic carrier Sun Air have been shortlisted to go through to the next stage of the selection process, South Africa's Ministry of Transport said on Monday.
Four bids were received for the sale of 100 percent of the airline from Malaysia Airlines Consortium, Virgin Atlantic Bhekilanga Consortium, Comair Consortium and Phoenix Venture Partners Consortium.
The sale -- South Africa's first full privatisation -- is expected to be concluded by August.

The shortlisted bidders will be given access to management and other information regarding Sun Air and the ministry said it expected to receive final binding bids by July 21. After that, one bid will be selected and recommended to government by the Sun Air restructuring committee.
Industry analysts have speculated that the sale of Sun Air could fetch around 100 million rand. The airline operates eight aircraft on routes between Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban.
